semantic_fidelity.reason: All 18 identities and all 28 required endpoint/direction/label-meaning triples appear exactly once across v1-v4, with no extra visible relation or invented protocol. FW1 active/FW2 standby state is legibly carried by every incident link in v2. v3 honors common top row 28 for BL/rack leaves and spines above; v4 completes the split coverage. The physical-link arrow convention is explicitly stated in generation.json/md, not a traffic claim. The e20 local owner defect is scored under arrow_traceability, not a missing or false relation.

arrow_traceability.reason: All 28 source stems and target heads are independently traceable with no bundled links or actual branch glyphs. However, ECMP [17,12,4,1] in v3 has two equally close candidate routes (D03), and Leaf 2 -> Rack 1 contains an avoidable two-step jog (D04). Green checks do not waive either gate. Other conspicuously long v3 routes are not independently condemned solely for length: their fixed side-port geometry accounts for their runs.

layout_fit.reason: Every final captured grid is 77x47 at 100%, measured by the running app header; all boxes/labels fit, with no clip/overlay loss. Null pane rectangles and unknown check viewport are not blockers because the frozen rubric accepts the app token. Nonetheless v1 has two avoidable carrier-feed bridges and v3 has two avoidable BL/spine bridges (D01/D02), without any need to reorder source groups/tiers. Observed counts are 3/2/4/1 bridges, not the eight reported touching bends counted as extra crossings.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Within every view, source-related carrier/aggregation/core/firewall/edge/spine/leaf/rack concepts use related hue families and proximity. v3 keeps spines above the common BL/leaf band and racks below. Three repeated groups change hue across views, as observed blind, but the full task expressly says cross-view per-node hue stability is not a separate gate. No source-named conceptual band is reordered to lower crossings.

border_integrity.reason: All 26 node occurrences have all sides and rounded corners, with continuous per-node normal ANSI color. All-selected captures cover 26/26 perimeters in continuous bold gold, including nodes already gold in normal state. This proves those saved selected borders, not hover/drag histories.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen skill, renderer, rubric, dataset, source and final-spec hashes verify; raw check/probe files, normal/ANSI/all-selected captures, app-measured header sizes, capture/check windows and confirmed_closed manifests exist. The blind file was saved before reveal. Required exact final operation commands, stderr accounting, rejected/preflight exit-status records and raw pane-close results are absent (G01), so workflow cannot pass. No frame dumps exist for final views; that is a disclosed nonblocking limitation for this explicitly static case, not an animation substitute.

animation.reason: Applicable as the explicit no-dots prohibition: source original chat line 134 and expected/dataset animation=off prohibit flowing dots. Literal scans of all 12 final visual captures show zero U+25CF glyphs; every edge has dots=0 and no flow field, and all four checks report flows=0. Thus no critical no-dots violation is observed. Positive-motion origin/speed/synchronization tests are source-backed N/A, not silently passed from a schema. Frames are absent; temporal absence outside captured states is not claimed.
